_notes: All ideas are real-life lifestyle content. 'niches': ['*'] = works for everyone. 'sticker' uses current (Sep 2026) IG features. Close-friends stories should feel like texting a group chat — lower production than main feed, more personality.

stories.title: First 10 minutes awake
stories.prompt: One clip of whatever actually happens first — alarm screen, stretching, opening blinds. No cleanup, that's the point.

stories.title: Breakfast verdict
stories.prompt: Photo of breakfast + poll: 'cooked or cereal-for-dinner energy?'

stories.title: Today's to-do list
stories.prompt: Screenshot or paper list of 3 real errands. Question box: 'what's on yours?'

stories.title: Coffee order reveal
stories.prompt: Cup in hand, Reveal sticker hiding what you ordered — 'guess my order' in the caption.

stories.title: Rate my coffee shop find
stories.prompt: Quick pan of a café corner + slider sticker to rate the vibe.

stories.title: What I'm actually eating
stories.prompt: Unstyled photo of a real meal. Caption one honest line ('girl dinner, no notes').

stories.title: Grocery haul mini-tour
stories.prompt: 60-second story walking through 5 things from the grocery run, one-line commentary each.

stories.title: Nail appointment chair cam
stories.prompt: Hand on the nail table mid-set + poll on the color choice before the reveal.

stories.title: Hair day documentation
stories.prompt: Before clip in the salon chair, after clip in the car. Two stories, hours apart — let people wait.

stories.title: Tonight's skincare lineup
stories.prompt: Products lined up on the counter, Frames sticker for the polaroid shake effect.

stories.title: Current cozy corner
stories.prompt: The spot you're actually sitting in right now — blanket, laptop, drink. Caption what you're watching.

stories.title: Candle of the week
stories.prompt: Close-up of the lit candle + question box: 'best candle scent you've ever bought?'

stories.title: Sunday reset in 3 clips
stories.prompt: Laundry pile → clean room → made bed. Three quick clips, satisfying arc.

stories.title: Passenger seat check-in
stories.prompt: Golden light through the car window, where-are-we-going one-liner. Add Yours Music sticker with the song playing.

stories.title: Errand fit + destination poll
stories.prompt: Mirror pic before leaving + poll: 'Target or TJ Maxx first?'

stories.title: Found this and thought of the gc
stories.prompt: One weird/cute item spotted while shopping. Cutout sticker it onto a plain background for the meme effect.

stories.title: Fit check, no context
stories.prompt: Mirror photo, one emoji caption. Let the comments do the work now that stories have them.

stories.title: This or that outfit
stories.prompt: Two outfit options side by side (collage), poll for which one wins tonight.

stories.title: Blurry night dump
stories.prompt: 3 imperfect flash photos from the night out, posted the morning after. Anti-perfection reads as real.

stories.title: What we ordered
stories.prompt: Overhead table shot at dinner with friends. Tag no one, explain nothing.

stories.title: Ask me anything, chaos edition
stories.prompt: Question box with a specific prompt ('decisions I need help making today') — specific prompts get 3x the answers of plain AMAs.

stories.title: Settle a debate
stories.prompt: Poll on a real tiny debate from your day (with a friend, with yourself). Report the results in a follow-up story.

stories.title: Add Yours chain
stories.prompt: Start an Add Yours: 'your current phone background' or 'last photo of your pet'. Chains recruit replies from lurkers.

stories.title: Little treat culture
stories.prompt: The $7 thing you bought yourself today. Caption: 'deserved.'

stories.title: Package day
stories.prompt: Opening a delivery on camera (60s story) — genuine first reaction, no unboxing-influencer voice.

stories.title: Goodnight screen
stories.prompt: Last story of the day: dim lamp, book or show on screen, one soft line. Consistent sign-offs build the 'texting a friend' feeling.

stories.title: Matcha making, no talking
stories.prompt: Whisking matcha in morning light, ambient sound only.

stories.title: Pilates proof
stories.prompt: Post-class mirror pic, hair still slick. Caption the honest part ('almost cancelled twice').

stories.title: Everything shower announcement
stories.prompt: Shelf of products + poll: 'everything shower tonight — yes or big yes?'

stories.title: Desk reset time-lapse
stories.prompt: 15-second time-lapse tidying your desk/vanity back to baseline.

stories.title: 5am club check-in
stories.prompt: Gym parking lot or front desk clock. Caption: 'we're here. barely.'

stories.title: Today's split poll
stories.prompt: Mirror pic in gym fit + poll: 'guess today's split — legs or upper?'

stories.title: Post-workout meal build
stories.prompt: 60s story assembling the actual post-gym meal, macro talk optional.

stories.title: Progress note to self
stories.prompt: Screenshot of a rep/weight PR from your tracking app. One proud sentence.

stories.title: Fresh flowers Friday
stories.prompt: Unwrapping grocery-store flowers into a vase. Frames sticker for the polaroid effect.

stories.title: Table situation
stories.prompt: Brunch table pan — hands, coffee, light. No faces needed.

stories.title: Tonight's ritual
stories.prompt: Bath running / robe / wine or tea. One elegant clip, soft audio.

stories.title: One nice thing
stories.prompt: Close-up of one luxe detail from today (jewelry, dessert, hotel key). Reveal sticker hiding where you are.

stories.title: Talking story: today's small chaos
stories.prompt: Front-camera 45 seconds telling one small ridiculous thing that happened. Story comments on.

stories.title: Pet interruption
stories.prompt: Whatever your pet is doing right now. Zero setup required, top-tier engagement.

stories.title: Thrift find judgment
stories.prompt: Hold up the questionable thrift find + poll: 'treasure or leave it?'

stories.title: Cooking attempt, live results
stories.prompt: Two stories: 'attempting this recipe' → the result, honest either way.

stories.title: Fit check, flash on
stories.prompt: Night flash photo of the fit against a plain wall. Grainy on purpose.

stories.title: Current rotation
stories.prompt: Add Yours Music sticker with the song you've had on repeat. Ask for trades.

stories.title: Next tattoo debate
stories.prompt: Sketch or reference photo + poll on placement. People have STRONG opinions.

stories.title: Soft hobby reveal
stories.prompt: The contrast content: crocheting, plants, baking — whatever soft thing you do. Caption: 'yes, this is also me.'

stories.title: GRWM checkpoint
stories.prompt: Half-done makeup, one brow up. Poll: 'lashes or no lashes tonight?'

stories.title: Final fit reveal
stories.prompt: The full look after a GRWM checkpoint story — make them wait 30+ minutes between the two.

stories.title: Makeup product on trial
stories.prompt: New product first impressions in one 60s story — real verdict, not a review voice.

stories.title: Golden hour, no caption needed
stories.prompt: The sunset from wherever you are. One a week minimum — it's your signature.

stories.title: Truck radio talking clip
stories.prompt: Front camera in the truck, windows down, one thought from today.

stories.title: Weekend plans poll
stories.prompt: Poll: 'lake or bonfire this weekend?' Then post whichever wins, closing the loop.

stories.title: Journal page corner
stories.prompt: Aesthetic partial shot of today's journal spread + question box: 'one thing you're grateful for today?'

stories.title: Farmers market haul
stories.prompt: Spread the haul on the counter, 60s story naming favorites.

stories.title: Currently reading
stories.prompt: Book + drink + one-line honest review so far. Question box for recommendations.

reels.concept: Silent day-in-the-life: 8-10 two-second clips of an ordinary day, trending calm audio. Use First Draft to auto-stitch the rough cut.

reels.hook: things in my apartment that just make sense
reels.concept: 5 quick pans to small home details with text labels. Low effort, high save-rate format.
Talking-head clips between stops, stitched with First Draft. Personality carries it, not the errands.
The aspirational routine format with honest captions ('skincare = whatever's closest'). Test as a Trial Reel first to see non-follower response.
Photo-dump reel of the month's best 15 photos on a nostalgic audio. Schedule as a Trial Reel for month-end.

reels.hook: what I ordered vs what arrived
reels.concept: Any purchase with an expectation/reality beat. Works even when the reality is fine.

reels.hook: POV: your friend who's always doing something
reels.concept: Fast montage of the week's activities, beat-synced in Edits with Loudness Match for clean audio.
Sped-up morning tidy + matcha + hair, one continuous vibe, no talking.

reels.hook: day in the life: girl who lifts
reels.concept: Alarm → gym → meal → work → night. Timestamps on screen. Trial Reel to reach non-followers in fitness.

reels.hook: what I eat in a day (realistic version)
reels.concept: Every meal, honest portions, no lecture. Evergreen format in fitness niche.
Cinematic slow clips of normal moments — coffee pour, book, walk — luxe audio.
Take yourself somewhere nice, film 6 clips, voiceover why solo dates matter.

reels.hook: rating everything I bought at Target
reels.concept: Haul with fast honest ratings out of 10. Comment bait: people defend their favorites.
Front-camera storytelling while doing a mundane task (folding laundry, makeup). First Draft trims the pauses.
3 outfit transitions cut on a heavy beat drop. Flash photo aesthetic.
The contrast format — tattoos then baking, boots then plants. Test as Trial Reel; contrast hooks travel.
Full glam voiceover GRWM telling a story unrelated to the makeup. The story retains, the glam converts follows.
Golden-hour montage: fields, tailgates, water, bonfire. Country audio, wide shots.

reels.hook: habits that changed my year (proof included)
reels.concept: Each habit shown being done, not talked about. Save-magnet format.

features_to_try.name: 60-second stories
features_to_try.why: Stories no longer split at 15s — talking clips and mini-vlogs flow better. Use for one longer 'talking to the gc' story per day max.

features_to_try.name: Story comments
features_to_try.why: Public comments on stories are new — turn them on for fit checks and talking stories; visible conversation makes close friends feel like a group chat.

features_to_try.name: Reveal sticker
features_to_try.why: Hides part of a story until viewers DM — natural curiosity mechanic for coffee orders, locations, before/afters. Use sparingly (max 1-2/week) so it stays fun.

features_to_try.name: Frames sticker
features_to_try.why: Polaroid shake-to-develop effect — perfect for flowers, nails, and film-photo energy.

features_to_try.name: Cutouts
features_to_try.why: Cut any object from a photo into a sticker — great for meme-y 'look at this thing I found' stories.

features_to_try.name: Add Yours Music
features_to_try.why: Song-trade chains recruit replies from people who never answer question boxes.

features_to_try.name: Trial Reels (+ scheduling)
features_to_try.why: Test a reel with non-followers only before committing it to your grid. Schedule one trial per week; promote winners.

features_to_try.name: First Draft
features_to_try.why: Auto-trims pauses across clips into an editable rough cut — cuts talking-reel edit time massively.

features_to_try.name: Edits app — Loudness Match
features_to_try.why: Evens out audio levels between clips so voiceovers sound clean without editing skill.
